pdf-lib 1.17.1
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
License: MIT. See pdf-lib.LICENSE.md.
The sourceMappingURL comment was removed so the page does not request a map file.

pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, legacy build
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0. See pdfjs-6.5.438/LICENSE.
pdfjs-6.5.438/pdf.min.js and pdf.worker.min.js are the official legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs and
legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs, renamed so they are served as JavaScript. The legacy build adds the
newest JavaScript built-ins when a browser lacks them. The modern build/ files assume every browser
has them and fail to draw pages in browsers that are a release or two behind.
cmaps/, standard_fonts/, wasm/, and iccs/ are the matching files from the same release.
The folder is named for the version so a browser never pairs a cached viewer with a newer worker.
To upgrade, add the new pdfjs-<version>/ folder, point PDFJS_DIR in app.js at it, and remove the old one.
